summary_en: ¥600M upper limit, 1,200,000 shares (4.36% of shares outstanding), ToSTNeT-3 method, settlement 2026-07-21 at ¥588/share closing price. Block acquisition from CyberAgent.
title_en: Notice regarding acquisition of treasury shares and purchase of treasury shares via off-auction (ToSTNeT-3) transaction
translation_en_brief:
On 17 July 2026, MicroAd's board resolved to acquire up to 1,200,000 treasury shares (4.36% of shares outstanding, ex-treasury) for a total of ¥600 million via ToSTNeT-3 off-auction transaction on 21 July 2026 at the closing price of ¥588 per share.

The acquisition targets shares being sold by CyberAgent, a related company. MicroAd states the purpose is to mitigate shareholder dilution from unsecured convertible bonds issued on the same date and from future stock option exercises and restricted stock awards to officers. The company also cites capital efficiency improvement.

CyberAgent has confirmed it intends to retain MicroAd shares long-term and has no plans to sell them on the market after this transaction. Results will be announced after the 21 July trading window closes.
